# @generated by stategate from system.yaml. Do not edit: change the system and run `stategate gen`.
#
# On a PC: cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build
# In ESP-IDF: add this folder to EXTRA_COMPONENT_DIRS. Each machine folder and
# router/ is then a component.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(logger_system C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(SG_WARNINGS -Wall -Wextra -Wswitch-enum -Werror)

file(GLOB device_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/device/src/gen/*.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/device/src/actions/*.c
     ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/device/src/services/*.c)
add_library(logger_system_device STATIC ${device_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(logger_system_device PRIVATE device/src)
target_compile_options(logger_system_device PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})

file(GLOB sampler_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sampler/src/gen/*.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sampler/src/actions/*.c
     ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sampler/src/services/*.c)
add_library(logger_system_sampler STATIC ${sampler_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(logger_system_sampler PRIVATE sampler/src)
target_compile_options(logger_system_sampler PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})

file(GLOB logger_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/logger/src/gen/*.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/logger/src/actions/*.c
     ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/logger/src/services/*.c)
add_library(logger_system_logger STATIC ${logger_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(logger_system_logger PRIVATE logger/src)
target_compile_options(logger_system_logger PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})

file(GLOB sensor_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sensor/src/gen/*.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sensor/src/actions/*.c
     ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sensor/src/services/*.c)
add_library(logger_system_sensor STATIC ${sensor_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(logger_system_sensor PRIVATE sensor/src)
target_compile_options(logger_system_sensor PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})

add_library(logger_system_router STATIC router/logger_system.c router/sg_queue.c)
target_compile_options(logger_system_router PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})
target_link_libraries(logger_system_router PUBLIC logger_system_device logger_system_sampler logger_system_logger logger_system_sensor)

include(FetchContent)
if(DEFINED ENV{STATEGATE_UNITY_DIR})
  set(FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_UNITY $ENV{STATEGATE_UNITY_DIR})
endif()
FetchContent_Declare(unity
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/ThrowTheSwitch/Unity.git
  GIT_TAG v2.6.0
  GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(unity)

enable_testing()
add_executable(logger_system_test_router router/test_router.c)
target_link_libraries(logger_system_test_router PRIVATE logger_system_router unity)
target_compile_options(logger_system_test_router PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})
add_test(NAME router COMMAND logger_system_test_router)

# The whole system on fake boards: build/logger_system_sim [--trace out.sgt] <run_ms> [machine.EVENT[@ms] ...]
add_executable(logger_system_sim router/sim.c)
target_link_libraries(logger_system_sim PRIVATE logger_system_router)
target_compile_options(logger_system_sim PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})
